newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Marine '96 net hits 181 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Marine '96 net hits 181 mln yuan.

text.p: China International Marine Containers (Group) Ltd reaped net profits of 181.48 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Friday.
Earnings per share were 0.903 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 3.48 billion yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
The company posted net profits of 138.90 million yuan under international accounting standards in 1995 and 138.14 million yuan under Chinese accounting standards.
The firm proposed to make a three-for-10 bonus share issue and a cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
